settings.title: Blush and
settings.summary: Baby pink Austin roses with light peach ranunculus in a cream vase.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Austin Roses | Baby Pink | 6 stems | B0DTFNXBHF | #e6b7b5 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Baby+Pink | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Light Peach | 4 stems | B0DTYG3SY1 | #eac3a9 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Light+Peach | Height
settings.method:
Place the six roses first, heads turned outward, so they sit a little above the rim.
Add the four ranunculus between them; their longer stems carry the flowers and buds above the roses.
Turn the vase until one side stands a little higher than the other.
settings.why: Two neighboring pinks. The Austin roses form the body; the ranunculus, on longer stems, rise above them and repeat the peach at the center of each rose.
settings.alt: Baby pink Austin roses with light peach ranunculus in a cream vase.

settings.title: Coral
settings.summary: Coral classic roses with orange ranunculus in a stone jug.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | Coral | 6 stems | B0DSWT9NMF | #d98268 | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=Coral | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Orange | 4 stems | B0DTYBG3DP | #dc884d | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Orange | Height
settings.method:
Place the roses first and let a few buds lean out over the lip.
Add the ranunculus behind and between the roses, where they stand taller.
Leave one side lighter than the other so the arrangement looks gathered, not packed.
settings.why: Coral and orange sit next to each other on the color wheel. The roses and their buds make the body; the orange ranunculus lift above them on longer stems.
settings.alt: Coral classic roses with orange ranunculus in a stone jug.

settings.title: White
settings.summary: White tulips, Austin roses and ranunculus in a wide stoneware crock.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | White | 12 stems | B0DQDXM72R | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=White | Base
1 | Austin Roses | White | 6 stems | B0DTFNZQRG | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=White | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | White | 4 stems | B0DTYJ5V1W | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=White | Height
settings.method:
Set the twelve tulips around the rim first and let them lean outward.
Place the roses through the center, above the tulips.
Add the ranunculus last; their longer stems carry them above everything.
settings.why: One color in three heights: tulips gathered low at the rim, Austin roses as the body, ranunculus above them with their round buds.
settings.alt: White tulips, Austin roses and ranunculus in a wide stoneware crock.

settings.title: Pink and
settings.summary: Green-and-pink tulips with pink Austin roses and pink ranunculus.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | Green With Pink Tip | 12 stems | B0DQF16XSS | #c5c6a3 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=Green+With+Pink+Tip | Base
1 | Austin Roses | Pink | 6 stems | B0DTFPD9F9 | #d982a6 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Pink | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Pink | 4 stems | B0DTYBPB9F | #d982a6 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Pink | Height
settings.method:
Set the tulips around the rim first, leaning out.
Place the roses in the middle, above the tulips.
Add the ranunculus last and let their buds stand above the roses.
settings.why: Three pinks in three heights, tied together by the green of the tulips: tulips low at the rim, roses through the middle, ranunculus on top.
settings.alt: Green-and-pink tulips with pink Austin roses and pink ranunculus.

settings.title: Soft
settings.summary: White classic roses with pink tips and baby pink ranunculus in a slim vase.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | White With Pink Tip | 6 stems | B0DSWSM1QY | #f2e4de | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=White+With+Pink+Tip | Focal
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Baby Pink | 4 stems | B0DTYL1GYT | #e6b7b5 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Baby+Pink | Height
settings.method:
Set the roses so the open blooms sit near the rim and the buds rise above them.
Add the ranunculus behind the roses, a little to one side, for an off-center outline.
Keep the top below the lampshade so the light falls on the petals.
settings.why: The pink edges on the white roses are picked up by the baby pink ranunculus, so the two sets read as one soft color. The ranunculus stand above the roses.
settings.alt: White classic roses with pink tips and baby pink ranunculus in a slim vase.

settings.title: Late
settings.summary: Burgundy classic roses with dark purple tulips in smoked glass.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | Burgundy | 6 stems | B0DSXY4KDH | #6d283f | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=Burgundy | Focal
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | Dark Purple | 12 stems | B0DQDVL846 | #654181 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=Dark+Purple | Base
settings.method:
Stand the tulips around the rim first and let them lean outward.
Place the roses through the middle, open blooms above the tulips and buds highest.
Light the table from one side; the dark petals need it.
settings.why: Burgundy and dark purple share their depth. The tulips gather low around the rim; the roses and their buds rise above them.
settings.alt: Burgundy classic roses with dark purple tulips in smoked glass.
